title: tint v4 config
description: JSON form of a tint v4 config (docs/v4-spec.md §2). Kind functions return this data. `$schema` may be set on a JSON config (§7, §8).

palette.description: Named palette colors (§2.2). At least one. Names are CSS identifiers (escapes are not accepted). The first entry is the default palette unless `default` is set.

^-?(?:[A-Za-z_]|[^\\u0000-\\u007F])(?:[A.description: A CSS color, or a palette color object (§2.2).

themes.description: Theme map. Default when omitted: `{ light: { mode: "light" } }` (page lightness 96). Set lightness, mode, or extends.

tokens.description: Groups of tokens (§2.4). Groups contain only tokens. Group and token names match ^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_-]*$.

overrides.description: Per-palette token replacements. Keys are palette names, or several joined by commas ("warning,info"). A token with kind replaces; options merge. Applied after palette tune.

contrast.title: ContrastOptions
contrast.description: Which contrast table to use, and how far to shift it (§2.1, §5).

themeContrast.title: ThemeContrastOptions
themeContrast.description: A theme may override the contrast level, not the algorithm (§2.3).

color.description: Any CSS color. Supplies hue and chroma; lightness is solved (§2.2).

default.description: Make this the unprefixed palette. Otherwise the first palette color is.

exact.description: `true` snaps the first emphasis rest token to `color` when it passes. A "group.token" path snaps that token (§2.2, §6.5).

tune.description: Per-palette-color overrides keyed by token path (§2.2). A Token replaces the token. TokenOptions merge.

paletteColorDelta.title: PaletteColorDelta
paletteColorDelta.description: Per-theme palette delta. Every field is optional (§2.3).

color.description: Any CSS color. Supplies hue and chroma; lightness is solved (§2.2).

default.description: Make this the unprefixed palette. Otherwise the first palette color is.

exact.description: `true` snaps the first emphasis rest token to `color` when it passes. A "group.token" path snaps that token (§2.2, §6.5).

tune.description: Per-palette-color overrides keyed by token path (§2.2). A Token replaces the token. TokenOptions merge.

token.title: Token
token.description: A token's kind, a numeric scale, and options. Level names and states are not part of this prototype.

scale.description: Numeric scale. emphasis, text, and border are contrast steps from 0 to 10 (higher is more contrast; decimals interpolate, APCA in Lc and WCAG by ratio; text(5) is body text). surface is signed lightness steps from the page, -10 to 10 (0 is the page, positive is raised, negative is sunken; one step is 0.02 in light and 0.03 in dark). Decimals are real steps.

disabled.description: Set by disabled.emphasis(n), disabled.text(n), disabled.surface(n), or disabled.border(n). n is how strong the color would have been. The scale does not change. The engine mutes it (chroma ×0.3, lightness at most 0.06 toward the backdrop). Solid color, no alpha.

chroma.description: Multiplier on the palette color's chroma, 0..2 inclusive (default 1; surfaces capped) (§2.4).

hue.description: Absolute hue in degrees, or a + / - shift (§2.4).

lc.description: Raw APCA target. Expert escape hatch; only with algorithm apca (§2.4).

ratio.description: Raw WCAG ratio. Expert escape hatch; only with algorithm wcag2 (§2.4).

tokenOptions.title: TokenOptions
tokenOptions.description: Options merged onto a token by palette `tune` or top-level `overrides`. A replacement token is a Token and includes `kind` and `scale`.

chroma.description: Multiplier on the palette color's chroma, 0..2 inclusive (default 1; surfaces capped) (§2.4).

hue.description: Absolute hue in degrees, or a + / - shift (§2.4).

lc.description: Raw APCA target. Expert escape hatch; only with algorithm apca (§2.4).

ratio.description: Raw WCAG ratio. Expert escape hatch; only with algorithm wcag2 (§2.4).

kindLevelNames.title: KindLevelNames
kindLevelNames.description: Aliases for one kind (§2.5). Values are ordinals 1–5. `$replace: true` drops the built-in names, including `default`.

stateStepCounts.title: StateStepCounts
stateStepCounts.description: Per-state step counts (§4). `active` is an alias of `pressed`.

hover.description: How many steps `hover` moves from the rest token (§4).

pressed.description: How many steps `pressed` moves from the rest token (§4).

focus.description: How many steps `focus` moves from the rest token (§4).

selected.description: How many steps `selected` moves from the rest token (§4).

checked.description: How many steps `checked` moves from the rest token (§4).

disabled.description: How many steps `disabled` moves from the rest token (§4).

active.description: Step count for the `active` alias of `pressed` (§4).

surfaceStateSteps.title: SurfaceStateSteps
surfaceStateSteps.description: Surface step counts, plus the OKLCH lightness size of one step (§4).

emphasisStateSteps.description: Emphasis step counts, plus the OKLCH lightness size of one tint step (§4).

theme.title: ThemeOptions
theme.description: Theme options. Set lightness (0..100), mode as shorthand (light 96 / dark 15), or extends to inherit either.

lightness.description: Page lightness, 0..100. Polarity is inferred (50 and above is light). mode: light is 96. mode: dark is 15.

media.description: `true` means `prefers-color-scheme` matching `mode`. A string is a custom media query.

palette.description: Per-theme palette deltas. A string replaces `color` (§2.3).

format.description: Emitted color notation. Default `oklch`. Internal math stays OKLCH (§7).

prefix.description: Optional CSS identifier prepended to every custom property (§7). `"tint"` emits `--tint-brand-action-hover` and alias `--tint-action-hover`. Omit it for no prefix. Utility names stay `tint-<palette>`.
